safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold specifies penicillin allergy, but Generated only documents an unspecified 'medicine' allergy and does not name penicillin.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failing to specify a penicillin allergy (and instead recording only an unspecified “medicine” allergy) can lead to inadvertent prescribing/administration of penicillin-class antibiotics, risking serious allergic reaction including anaphylaxis. Allergy documentation errors are high-risk because they directly affect medication safety decisions.
